notes: The three heads share one level: «قال إسحاق أخبرنا» gives Ishaq's verb with no name of its own, and the one name written after «وقال الآخران» is «وكيع», common to all three heads
«قال سمعت مجاهدا، يحدث عن طاوس» — Mujahid and Tawus are links (rule 5)
The Prophet's words are relayed by Ibn Abbas; the Prophet is not a link
